studies.title: 古旧墙雕与金属饰件
studies.text: 浅浮雕、磨损铜饰、旧挂钩和铆钉附着原墙面；以雕刻深度、积雪边缘和接触阴影丰富墙面，不增加柱墙或突出结构。
studies.detail: FOCUS: Weathered shallow stone relief and small aged metal fittings on the existing straight parapet. Two different eroded knotwork/snowflake relief panels carved shallowly into ordinary wall bays, a small oxidized bronze crest fixed FLUSH to a stone panel, a few old iron anchor rings and rivets. Carving depth is subtle but tangible, no giant emblem or new monument. Snow catches the upper carved ledges, tiny icicles, dark mortar and worn chipped corners, gentle blue ambient bounce. Leave some wall bays plain so the detail is not repetitively applied everywhere. No hanging banner, no new fence. Show sufficient open paving to judge scale. No doorway, no niche, no shrine or pillar projecting into the road.
studies.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. New environment DETAIL CONCEPT for the existing frozen bridge game. Use the reference approved map ONLY for its art direction: highly detailed hand-painted pixel-like snowy Gothic stone, cool desaturated blue-grey palette, subtle ice blue, deep stone crevices, convincing top/side planes, firm contact shadows and solid dimensional forms. Fixed elevated 45 degree game view, landscape 16:9. A close scene, not a whole map and not a prop contact sheet. Subdued frozen canyon background.
BUILDABILITY: One single intact CONTINUOUS STRAIGHT parapet crosses the entire frame from lower left to upper right; every wall panel and ordinary square post lies on exactly the same baseline. NO perpendicular return wall, corner, L/T junction, projecting wall stub, alcove, enclosure, broken wall gap, new staircase or added platform. The road-facing inner wall is visible, with a shallow shoulder strip parallel to it and a broad flat open paved combat road in the foreground. Do not change the bridge outline. Decorations stay attached to the flat wall face or in the narrow shoulder. Preserve clear traversable roadway, normal prop scale and plausible stone thickness. NO vegetation, no reeds, no grass tufts, no little bushes; gameplay concealment brush is a separate approved design and must not be replaced by decorative patches. No new guardian or humanoid statue, no character, no text, no labels, no UI, no neon magic, no oversized hero object. Details must feel grounded and useful for later modular asset production.

studies.title: 墙脚霜晶与冰蚀
studies.text: 低矮霜晶沿原墙脚裂缝聚集，搭配薄冰、冻融剥落和湿冷砖缝；高度明显低于英雄藏身草丛，不构成新的隐蔽区或大型障碍。
studies.detail: FOCUS: Restrained LOW ice crystal growth and freeze-thaw material detail at the foot of the intact straight wall. Two widely spaced shallow clusters of small translucent smoky ice-blue crystal blades emerge from EXISTING narrow mortar cracks right against the wall foot. Most blades below one quarter of the parapet height, no giant crystals, crystal garden or towers. A thin frosted ice skin on a few shoulder cobbles, subtle frozen water trails and salt-like frost, tiny flakes of stone, old mortar repairs and sparse snow dust. Thick bases and realistic transparent-to-opaque crystal faces, grounded contact shadows, crisp snow resting on small facets. Nothing glowing neon or extending across the main road. Leave most of the shoulder bare. No new crack splitting the bridge, no hole, no low return wall, no vegetation.

studies.title: 火盆灰烬与融雪
studies.text: 以小火盆及熄火盆周边的烟熏、炭屑、浅融雪圈和湿石痕迹补充使用感；暖光集中在局部，保留大片冷色铺地。
studies.detail: FOCUS: Environmental traces around existing-style small ground-level stone fire bowls placed on the shallow shoulder beside the straight wall. One modest lit bowl with restrained amber flame and one smaller extinguished bowl separated by plain paving farther along the same wall, both with low ring-shaped carved stone rims, no pedestals. Ash, a few charred wood fragments and soot are tightly contained at the bowls, small SHALLOW melted-snow halos reveal dark wet paving and a couple reflective meltwater streaks following mortar joints. Subtle soot staining on wall directly behind, ice resumes beyond the warm halo. Tangible heavy worn stone bowl rims and ember depth, soft local amber bounce, overall scene remains icy blue grey. No bonfire, burning building, huge red-orange glow, scattered obstacles, stacked firewood pile, new column, firepit enclosure or sunken floor.
